download.body: The file contains the whole database, including every account's password hash. Its two-factor secrets are encrypted, except in backups taken before the update that encrypts them.

backup.dirCheckFailed: Glou could not check whether it can write to the backups folder. Reload the page; if this message stays, check the API logs (docker compose logs api).
backup.dirNotWritable: The backups folder is not writable by Glou: every backup will fail. With docker compose, in your Glou folder on the server, run: mkdir -p backups && sudo chown 1001:1001 backups, then restart the stack. With Portainer or a NAS UI, replace ./backups with an absolute host path (e.g. /opt/glou/backups), give that folder to uid 1001 (sudo chown 1001:1001 /opt/glou/backups) and redeploy the stack.
backup.retentionDaysHint: Backup files older than this delay are automatically deleted (7 days minimum recommended).

restore.stepUp: Restore this backup over all current data?
restore.modalBody: This immediately overwrites all current data on this instance with the content of this backup.
restore.safetyCopy: A backup of the current data is taken first and stays in the history: restore it to undo this restore. If that backup fails, nothing is restored.

errors.BACKUP_BEFORE_RESTORE_FAILED: The backup of the current data taken before the restore failed, so nothing was restored. Check the backup history.
errors.BACKUP_FROM_OLDER_VERSION: This backup was taken by an earlier version of Glou, before an update: nothing was restored. To go back to that version, follow "Go back" on the wiki page "Upgrade Glou and go back if something goes wrong". To keep the current version with this data, restore it with the command of the "Disaster recovery" page, then restart the API: Glou updates it.
errors.BACKUP_FROM_NEWER_VERSION: This backup was taken by a newer version of Glou: nothing was restored. Update Glou, then restore it.
errors.BACKUP_FILE_MISSING: This backup file is no longer in the backups folder: nothing was restored. Reload the page to refresh the history.
errors.TIMEOUT: The restore is taking longer than expected and is still running on the server. Wait a few minutes, then reload the page and check the backup history.

csv.title: CSV Import

French headers and category names (nom, producteur, catégorie, millésime, prix, quantité, degré, cave, date d'achat, contenance, vitole, format de boîte; vin, bulles, spiritueux, cigare) work too.
